body: In a Claude Code session GITTOC_OWNER is unset, USER is the human, and CLAUDECODE=1 plus CLAUDE_CODE_* are present, so every agent action is attributed to the human. Proposal: when GITTOC_OWNER is unset and an agent harness is detectable, default the owner to the agent name; otherwise fall back to USER and warn once in non-interactive sessions. Needs owner decision on detection per agent (claude, github, openai, opencode).
title: attribute agent actions to the agent, not $USER, when GITTOC_OWNER is unset
